Kestrel sample engine - build notes (synthetic test fixture)

Toolchain
  The sample engine builds with a C++20 compiler and CMake 3.28 or later.
  The sample app builds with the .NET SDK 9.

Configurations
  debug     no optimisation, all assertions, memory tracking on
  profile   optimised, assertions on, profiler markers on
  release   optimised, assertions off, profiler markers off

Asset packs
  Packs are built by the pack tool and mounted read-only at start-up.
  Each pack stores a CRC-32 per file. A pack whose checksum does not match
  is refused, and the app falls back to loose files when they exist.
